summary: Backend-only tests for offboarding auto_approve, default draft, reconcile-terminated, and CRM /team-members membership-based filtering. All 5 tests passed against preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/people-ops/employees returns ALL employees (including terminated) by default. Frontend must pass ?status=active (or filter client-side) to hide terminated employees. The review request assumed the endpoint has an implicit active filter — it does not. Confirmed the terminated employee is correctly excluded when ?status=active is used.
reconcile-terminated endpoint has no role/permission check beyond get_current_user — any authenticated user in the company can trigger a bulk mutation. Consider restricting to admin/hr.

CRM /team-members still combines memberships filter with users.is_active {$ne: False}. This matches user C case (field missing) but if a user's is_active is explicitly False while membership is active, they will be excluded. Behavior appears intentional but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral employees, offboarding records, users, and memberships prefixed with test_iter225_ / usr_test225_ / mem_test225_ and clean them up in finally blocks.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_offboarding_crm_iter225.py. Requires env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME. All 5 tests passed. Covers: (1) POST /people-ops/offboarding with auto_approve=true → offboarding.status='approved', employee.status='terminated'; (2) POST without auto_approve → draft + employee remains active; (3) POST /offboarding/reconcile-terminated fixes stuck approved records; (4) GET /crm/team-members includes users with active membership (even if users.is_active missing), excludes users with removed membership; (5) empty case returns list.
rca_of_the_issue: Fixes verified. Auto-approve branch correctly sets both offboarding.status='approved' and employee.status='terminated' atomically in a single POST. Reconcile endpoint correctly repairs historical stuck records. CRM team-members refactor to memberships-first correctly excludes removed users while including users with missing is_active field.
